# Roleplay Rule 2 - Escalation and roleplay.
Escelate actions reasonably, behave as a rational person.
Don't just start beating people who upset you, act like a normal person and try to descelate.
If people continue to be a problem, you can escelate to fighting them.
## Examples
### [bold] Permitted [/bold]
- Killing / fighting someone for walking into your department after attempting multiple times to get them out with words / threatening them. - Killing someone trying to kill you. - Fighting someone trying to fight you. - Fighting someone who agreed to fight you. - Fighting an antagonist attacking your department.
### [bold] Not Permitted [/bold]
- Killing / Beating someone for walking into your department. - Killing / Beating someone for annoying you. - Killing / Beating someone for stealing something from you.
